text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — EU canary showing ingress 503 spike and autoscaler oscillation, putting rollout 1.42.0 promotion on hold for EU.

deploybot: HOLD applied: release=1.42.0 scope=eu-promotion reason=ingress-p99 by=olivia :warning:

maria: ack. freezing promotions only or full pipeline?

olivia: promotions only (canary -> region). CI and image builds unaffected. No fleet rollback yet.

sam: we've been seeing 503s from canary since ~12:20 UTC, might be noisy alerts if left running. recommend soft rollback?

ben: svc-owner here. I propose soft rollback canary -> 1.41.7 to quiet the noise and let SRE investigate infra vs code. Avoid wide rollback until we confirm.

maria: +1. i'll flag release notes and notify support on-call.

nate: SRE note: investigating LB connection saturation and pod churn. Soft rollback will help isolate.

deploybot: Soft rollback command:
```
deploy rollback --release=1.42.0 --to=1.41.7 --scope=canary --note="ingress 503s"
```

olivia: running soft rollback now. will report back in 15m and decide whether to lift hold or escalate to full rollback.

sre-bot: Incident created: incident-2034 (ingress p99 spike). Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/s/ingress/overview

ben: pausing noncritical cron jobs and scheduled backfills for EU for 30m to reduce noise.

olivia: rollback executed. canary traffic reverted to 1.41.7. preliminary p99 improved but still slightly elevated. keeping promotion hold until stable (+30m).

sam: seeing fewer 5xx from canary hosts, looks promising. agree to hold until the stability window completes.

nate: continuing root-cause on LB queues and autoscaler thresholds, will post findings. if infra is root cause we'll re-run canary with tuned ramp and extra logs.

maria: updating confluence release page and changelog: https://confluence.redwood/release/1.42.0 — noting hold, rollback, contacts. drafting short internal customer note in case EU GA slips.

olivia: thanks. will reopen if metrics worsen. otherwise plan: after stability window, retry canary with throttled ramp and debug flags enabled. :thumbsup:
